profile.headline: Senior Business Analyst | Technical Delivery | Requirements, UAT amp; Platform Engineering
profile.summary:
Im a Senior Business Analyst who bridges business needs and engineering. Ive turned requirements into working solutions for the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, a financial institution, and a global automaker, with hands-on depth in software quality, CI/CD automation, and enterprise platform administration. 

A few examples of the work: 

- Veterans Affairs: Helped develop a medical claims processing solution and documented requirements for VETSNET (SHARE, FTS, COVERS). Later helped remediate IFCAP application issues that were delaying veterans medical claims, and set up funding-threshold alerts so users could request more funds. 

- Farm Credit Bank of Texas: Supported the CME loan origination and Optimist credit analysis applications for the bank and its 14 associations, for a smoother loan and application process for customers. Earlier, led a Knowledge Management solution on Microsoft SharePoint that replaced Adobe FrameMaker, avoiding an estimated $10K+ in licensing costs. 

- General Motors: Specialized in JFrog Artifactory on the Binary Tools and Software Management team, supporting developers across GM globally, including China. Led an AI-enabled support rollout (Slack and Glean AI) that achieved 95%+ issue resolution within SLA. 

Also led CI/CD modernization across approximately 70 Manufacturing application streams as a Senior DevOps Engineer, and served as QA lead in Global Purchasing amp; Supply Chain. Also experienced in roadmaps, milestone planning, dependency management, and stakeholder alignment across cross-functional teams. 

Core strengths: requirements discovery and management, user stories, process mapping, UAT, Agile/Scrum, Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, REST APIs, SQL, Azure DevOps, Datadog. 

I'm looking for my next Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst role, where I can pair analyst rigor with technical depth. Open to Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, and Systems Analyst roles.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer — JFrog Artifactory Platform
positions.description:
Member of GM's Binary Tools and Software Management team, the enterprise tools team through which approved software solutions are delivered. Specialized in JFrog Artifactory, supporting developers across GM globally, including China.
• Administered enterprise JFrog Artifactory (on-premises and SaaS), managing local, remote, virtual, and federated repositories, user onboarding, group administration, and role-based access controls.
• Created and managed remote repositories so GM's China affiliates could securely download and use applications without impacting U.S. servers.
• Led rollout of an AI-enabled support ecosystem (Slack + custom Glean AI assistant), owning planning, stakeholder adoption, and success metrics end to end, achieving more than 95% issue resolution within SLA.
• Established observability in Datadog with dashboards, alert thresholds, SLIs, SLOs, and KPIs; sustained MTTR under 60 minutes and Change Failure Rate below 0.2%.
• Facilitated discovery and solution-design sessions with Engineering, Product, and stakeholders to translate business needs into platform solutions.
• Developed custom JFrog user plugins and automation (Groovy, TypeScript, Bash, REST APIs, AQL) to automate repository provisioning, permissions, artifact discovery, and usage audits, reducing operational toil and enabling developer self-service.
• Designed ServiceNow onboarding and access-request workflows, and built an integration with the Security team's API to digitally sign artifacts upon production upload.
• Drove repository lifecycle governance (retention policies, cleanup automation, storage optimization), removing outdated Docker images to free terabytes of storage and reduce infrastructure costs while strengthening RBAC.
• Helped shape the roadmap and execution of the on-premises-to-JFrog Cloud SaaS migration using Terraform modules, GitHub Actions, and self-service Slack workflows, maintaining operational continuity.

positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer, Manufacturing
positions.description:
• Led CI/CD modernization across approximately 70 Manufacturing application streams, migrating pipelines from Jenkins to Azure DevOps, standardizing build pipelines, automating compliance guardrails, and increasing automated test coverage to over 70%.
• Designed and implemented CI/CD pipelines with blue/green deployments across legacy and containerized applications (WebLogic, Docker), establishing a zero-downtime release baseline for critical software upgrades.
• Engineered Bash and Groovy automation for pre- and post-ingestion workflows in JFrog Artifactory, eliminating manual interventions in binary lifecycle management.
• Integrated artifact management governance into centralized Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions pipelines to streamline enterprise deployments and improve developer delivery efficiency.

positions.title: Senior Software Test Engineer, Global Purchasing & Supply Chain (GPSC)
positions.description:
• QA lead for several projects across GM's Global Purchasing and Supply Chain (GPSC) organization, managing junior QA testers and quality activities.
• Defined a test automation strategy that prioritized automation by business value and efficiency, and oversaw test planning, execution, defect triage, and reporting across Agile/Scrum and Waterfall SDLCs.
• Developed automated test suites and scripting frameworks using Selenium WebDriver, IntelliJ, Visual Studio, and Perfecto cloud testing environments.
• Validated data with T-SQL queries and led requirement reviews to align test coverage with business needs.

positions.title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
positions.description:
• Facilitated configuration of the Credit Management Enterprise (CME) loan origination and Optimist credit analysis applications for the bank and its 14 associations, leading SME sessions to capture current processes and requirements; the result was a smoother loan and application process for customers.
• Ensured third-party vendors honored SOW requirements and built Excel (macro/VB) simulations to gather feedback for configuration.
• Developed user stories and UAT scenarios from business requirements to validate application performance.
• Created AS-IS and baseline process models in MS Visio and Enterprise Architect to standardize processes across the Farm Credit district.
positions.insights: Skills: Stakeholder Management · Requirements Gathering · Cross-functional Team Leadership · User Stories

positions.title: Senior Business System Analyst
positions.description:
• Supported the IFCAP application (Integrated Funds Distribution, Control Point Activity, Accounting and Procurement), remediating issues that delayed veterans' medical claims processing.
• Set up IFCAP alerts that notify users when funding reaches a defined threshold percentage, so they can request additional funds.
• Planned and facilitated requirements sessions and prioritized the requirements backlog by business need, improving Business/Development alignment, contributing to a 15% increase in deliverables, and reducing cycle time for high-priority items by 20%.
• Partnered with stakeholders on UAT and maintained traceability from requirements through development and delivery.
• Previously held High Risk Public Trust and Moderate Risk (MBI) federal background investigations (inactive).

positions.title: Senior Business System Analyst
positions.description:
• Helped develop a state-of-the-art medical claims processing solution, eliciting and documenting business requirements (BRDs) for VETSNET (SHARE, FTS, and COVERS), a suite of tools for processing veterans' benefits.
• Created user stories, process models, UI mockups, requirements traceability matrices (RTMs), and software design documentation, tracking deliverables in TFS.
• Facilitated client and IT alignment sessions and supported end-to-end UAT by translating business requirements into acceptance scenarios and coordinating validation with stakeholders; contributed to a 40% increase in deliverables.
• Previously held High Risk Public Trust and Moderate Risk (MBI) federal background investigations (inactive).

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description: • Facilitated SME sessions to capture functional and technical requirements and produced technical documentation for Cisco's TelePresence system and other technologies, enabling a smooth transition of Cisco intellectual property to Telstra, a major client in Australia.
positions.insights: Skills: Stakeholder Management · Requirements Gathering · User Stories

positions.title: Business Systems Analyst
positions.description:
• Spearheaded an enterprise Knowledge Management solution that replaced cost-prohibitive Adobe FrameMaker with a Telerik WYSIWYG HTML Rich-Text Editor integrated into Microsoft SharePoint, avoiding an estimated $10K+ in licenses for about 12 content authors.
• Architected a hybrid document workflow that turned static file storage into a dynamic, web-based content authoring platform, letting every SharePoint user across the company contribute content.
• Facilitated requirements and process-mapping sessions, created UAT scenarios, and developed online procedural and training documentation for 19 nationwide associations on newly implemented loan accounting software.
positions.insights: Skills: Stakeholder Management · Requirements Gathering · User Stories

positions.title: Technical Product Delivery Lead (progressed from Technical Support Technician)
positions.description:
• Led the transition of all Dell Support Center development activities to Shanghai, China, coordinating third-party vendors, assessing global content needs, and using SQL queries on regional call-center data to route the right content to each country.
• Managed up to four concurrent technical documentation projects through the full lifecycle, leading international cross-functional meetings with Marketing, Engineering, Program Management, and Legal to meet program schedules and product ship dates.
• Created global web-based support alerts and documentation targeting top call drivers, translated into 20+ languages, contributing approximately $4M in annual support-call savings.
• Key participant in a business process improvement (BPI) project that improved alerting-process cycle time by 30% (approximately $150K annual savings).
• Began as a Technical Support Technician supporting approximately 6,000 customers annually; partnered with Quality Project Managers to identify top call drivers and pre-release issues on Inspiron and Dimension systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Stakeholder Management · Cross-functional Team Leadership · User Stories
